algorithm: Perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the given node to explore all reachable vertices in the undirected graph.
Track visited vertices to avoid cycles and ensure each vertex is processed once.
Collect all vertices visited during BFS to form the connected component.
Sort the collected vertices in ascending order to produce the output list.
constraints: The graph is simple and undirected with vertices 0 to n-1
The graph may contain isolated vertices
The output must be a sorted list of vertex strings
The function assumes the graph is undirected and does not handle directed graphs
edge_cases: Graph with a single node (no edges): returns [str(node)]
Node is isolated (no edges connected to it): returns [str(node)]
Graph with multiple disconnected components: returns only the component containing the specified node
Input node is the only node in the graph: returns [str(node)]
parsed.inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n; node: valid vertex in the graph
parsed.output: Ascending list of vertices (as strings) in the connected component containing the specified node.
parsed.purpose: Return the ascending list of vertices in the connected component of a simple undirected graph that contains a specified node, including isolated vertices.
